basis: closed-loop nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom conventional-airplane plant with aerodynamic, propulsion, gravity, navigation, feedback-control, and dynamic-actuator paths
more than six coupled physical and information subsystems and a 4725-block, 494-subsystem fixed source model
nonlinear rigid-body and aerodynamic dynamics, dynamic actuators, waypoint supervisory logic, and crosswind disturbance rejection
three independent input axes and three public dynamic output families with strong measured sensitivity
five private conditions combining waypoint geometry, both crosswind signs, and an initial-airspeed boundary

A.meaning: flight-state and waypoint-tracking trajectory accuracy across all private conditions

Q.meaning: finite complete public logs plus task-specific state and actuator smoothness

M.meaning: causal response to waypoint, crosswind, and initial-airspeed interventions across flight, tracking, and actuator paths

C.meaning: connected feedback tracking and actuator-to-flight causal behavior

R.meaning: worst private-condition flight, tracking, and actuator performance

D.meaning: velocity, body-rate, actuator-transient, and waypoint-sequence dynamics

score_policy.within_group: task-specific weighted arithmetic aggregation with explicit worst-condition retention
score_policy.across_groups: weighted geometric mean; absent critical mechanism groups may be zero

minimum_shortcut_sanity_contract: baseline output replayed for every private condition
command copied directly as measured position with fabricated zero tracking error
